summary.en: The first word fills the screen and drifts closer, then shrinks into its place as the line slides home; the other words are pushed in after it.
summary.zh: 首词先以 2.3 倍占满画面并继续推近，再沿同一条曲线缩回、整行滑回原位，后面的词从右侧依次推入成句。

fits: A line whose first word or phrase is the subject (a product name, "Introducing", "Weekly review,"): the lead alone first, then the sentence it belongs to; a launch-style opening.
notFor: Lines whose key word is not first; lines over about 32 characters (14 in Chinese), or a lead over about 14 characters (at 2.3× it leaves the frame).

intent.en: Reading order becomes physical order: the viewer is made to read the lead word alone first, then sees the sentence grow round it, and has read the subject twice.
intent.zh: 把阅读顺序做成物理顺序：观众被迫先单独读首词，再看整句围绕它长出来，落定时主词已经读了两遍。

content.en: One line (≤ 32 chars) whose first word or phrase (≤ 14 chars) is the subject; optional sub line (≤ 50 chars).
content.zh: 一句话（≤ 14 字），首词或首个词组（≤ 6 字，或一个拉丁字母产品名）就是主语；副行可选（≤ 22 字）。

fits.zh: 首词或首个词组就是主语的一句话（产品名、“Introducing”、“每周回顾，”）：先单独给首词，再补出整句；发布会式开场。

notFor.zh: 关键词不在句首的句子；超过约 32 个字符（中文 14 字）的句子，或超过约 14 个字符的首词（放大 2.3 倍会出画）。

pairs.note: a crash zoom after the line is set hands over to the next scene

en: Only one word in the accent; two coloured words leave the viewer unsure which to remember.
The lead must be short: over about 14 characters the 2.3× word overflows and its end is lost.
A crash zoom after it is the first half of a transition; to end on it, hold still or fade instead.
zh: 强调色只给一个词，两个词都上色观众不知道记哪个。
首词要短：超过约 14 个字符，放大 2.3 倍就溢出画面，词尾读不到。
接在后面的急推是转场的前半式；要在这里收尾就改成静止停留或淡出。

upstream.name: 首词推近组句
upstream.summary: 首词以 2.3 倍字号占据画面中央、hold 期间继续推近 6%，随后一条曲线同时完成「缩回终字号」与「整行左滑归位」，后续词各自从槽位右侧 0.5em 被推进来；支点横向钉首词中心、纵向钉基线（挂载时实测），整行上移的同一时窗副行浮出，停一拍后整幕 crash-zoom 推近失焦交棒
upstream.use: 品牌名/产品名的 Introducing 字卡；发布会式开场第二镜；一句话主张需要"先让一个词占满画面、再把整句补齐"的场合
upstream.energy: 中高（起手就是满画面的大字，但全程只有一次运动，没有二次冲击）

overlaps.note: the closing crash zoom of the upstream shot is viewport-push or whip-push after this brick
type-enter gives every unit of a title the same short way in; lead-word shows the first word alone at 2.3× and builds the line round it
